answer: Since the throttle counters live in the karst ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 180 keys as a result pays for 180 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the timber quota and the shale admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 7 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole army of identities at once. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
